# Tenki Builders Network — Mockup

> A tech-stack demonstration of a community + builders portal for Tenki,
> built on the same architecture as tenki.cloud (Next.js Pages Router,
> Gravity UI, Directus, Typesense, Azure Container Apps + Front Door).
> Not affiliated with Tenki. The Tenki web team can adopt this as a
> reference implementation when they're ready to ship a real builders
> network surface.

This is a working mockup — every page is rendered by the same toolchain
that powers tenki.cloud, with the same hashed-classname CSS, the same CMS
catch-all route, and the same headless search backend. The intent is that
the Tenki team can clone, adapt, and ship without context-switching from
how their main marketing site already works.

## What this site is

- **Audience:** the Tenki DevRel + web team (primary), AI builders who
  might join the program (secondary), and AI agents indexing the
  community ecosystem (tertiary).
- **Purpose:** show a working builders-network surface end-to-end so the
  internal team has a concrete artifact to react to, instead of slides.
- **Status:** mockup. Content is real (live event listings, real library
  resources, real community projects) but the portal flows are still
  evolving and the "join the program" path doesn't yet write to a
  production CRM.

## Primary surfaces

- [Home](https://demo.buildspace.sh/): map-hero of upcoming events,
  highlights of the library + apps + community.
- [Events](https://demo.buildspace.sh/events): every Tenki community
  event — workshops, hackathons, demo nights, meetups — across SF, NY,
  London, Berlin, Munich, and online. Filterable by city + Online.
- [Library](https://demo.buildspace.sh/library): 56 workshops, videos,
  and code repos for getting productive on Tenki. Filterable by type
  (Workshop / Video / Repo) and by product focus (AI Cloud, Token
  Factory, OpenClaw, Soperator).
- [Ecosystem](https://demo.buildspace.sh/ecosystem): unified directory
  of community-built apps PLUS partner integrations. Filterable by Kind
  (Community / Integration) and by product (AI Cloud, Tenki,
  OpenClaw, Soperator, Tavily). The two sub-views below show each
  source on its own.
- [Apps](https://demo.buildspace.sh/apps): community-built apps on
  Tenki. Filterable by product, hackathon track, and featured/award
  status. Each entry deep-links to /apps/<slug> for the project detail.
- [Integrations](https://demo.buildspace.sh/integrations): partner
  integrations — frameworks, gateways, orchestrators, observability
  tools that plug into Tenki products. Curated list with deep links
  to each integration's docs page.
- [Team](https://demo.buildspace.sh/team): the Tenki DevRel team and
  community advocates.
- [Office Hours](https://demo.buildspace.sh/office-hours): drop-in
  troubleshooting + product feedback sessions.
- [Builders](https://demo.buildspace.sh/builders): overview of the
  builders network program tiers + how to join.
- [Localhosts](https://demo.buildspace.sh/localhosts): community organizer
  pathway — run a Tenki event in your city.
- [Sign up](https://demo.buildspace.sh/signup): join the network.
- [About this build](https://demo.buildspace.sh/about-this-build):
  architecture notes, what's a mockup vs what's real.

## Programmatic access

- [Search API](https://demo.buildspace.sh/api/search?q=token+factory):
  unified search across library + events + apps. Returns JSON. Uses
  Typesense as primary, Directus as fallback. Query params: `q` (string),
  `limit` (1–60, default 24). Useful for agents looking up a specific
  topic across the corpus in one call.
- [Sitemap](https://demo.buildspace.sh/sitemap.xml): every public URL
  generated from Directus on each build.

## Tech stack

Documented at /about-this-build but the key facts agents may need:

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 Pages Router (not App Router — matches
  tenki.cloud's actual stack).
- **UI:** Gravity UI v7 + Page Constructor v6 (Yandex's open-source
  design system, same as tenki.cloud).
- **CMS:** Directus 11 self-hosted on Azure Container Apps.
- **Search:** Typesense, indexed via a Directus → Typesense sync script.
- **Hosting:** Azure Container Apps behind Azure Front Door Standard.
- **Auth:** Directus session cookies + GitHub OAuth driver.

## What to skip

- `/portal/*` and `/admin/*` — authed surfaces. Crawlers get redirected
  to /login.
- `/api/*` — internal endpoints except `/api/search` which is documented
  above.
- `/dev/*` — internal design playground (Phosphor mesh tuning).

## Source

Open-source mockup at github.com/opencolin/nebius-devsite. The repo is
intentionally self-contained: clone, `npm run dev:up`, the whole stack
(web + Directus + Postgres + Redis + Typesense) comes up in Docker
Compose. Treat the README and `infra/azure/README.md` as the canonical
explanation of how to run + deploy this.
